rationale.skip: Not skipping. No explicit opt-out is present (trigger_comment.txt and feature_hint.txt are empty; no tests-added label was passed). The change is user-facing — it alters the Traces search results grid's streaming/pagination behavior in web/src/plugins/traces/Index.vue.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The diff changes how the Traces page writes streamed result batches across pagination: replace-vs-append on the first write, clearing an exhausted/empty page, keeping prior rows under an error banner, and ignoring stale superseded requests. These are observable UI flows a user hits when searching and paginating traces.

rationale.group: The Traces shard in the CI matrix already owns tracesSearch, traceQueryEditor, traceErrorFilter, traceDetails, and traceAdvancedFiltering specs. This pagination/streaming result-write behavior is a natural fit for that same shard.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/plugins/traces/Index.spec.ts, a Vitest unit test — not Playwright E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ — so it does not count as existing E2E coverage for this feature.
